# Dr3amy Pages

> Dr3amy Pages is a static-page publishing platform that lets users publish web pages using GitHub-backed storage, without managing their own web server.

## About

Dr3amy Pages is a project developed under the ltnproject organization.

The service is designed to make publishing and hosting static web pages simple. Users can create and publish pages through the Dr3amy Pages web interface.

The public website is https://dr3amy.creepers.pro/.

Dr3amy Pages is a static-page publishing service. It should not be described as a general-purpose backend, database, or dynamic server unless those capabilities are separately documented.

## Main Pages

- [Dr3amy Pages Homepage](https://dr3amy.creepers.pro/): Main landing page explaining the service.
- [Dashboard](https://dr3amy.creepers.pro/dashboard.html): Dashboard interface.
- [Publishing Interface](https://dr3amy.creepers.pro/public/publish.html): Interface for publishing pages.

## Project and Source Code

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/ltnproject/dr3amy-pages): Source code and project files for Dr3amy Pages.
- [README](https://github.com/ltnproject/dr3amy-pages/blob/main/README.md): Project overview and setup information.
